messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: us-west-1 serving pool paging > 85% across redwood-runtime nodes (autoscale triggered). Sampled from 1791012339. page id: pg-uw1-0743

oncall-alex: saw it, joining. which models/paths?

oliver: looks like a spike correlated with int8/AWQ variants for gptx-7b serving group. KV mem per-request jumped ~3x. paging + continuous-batching = perf cliff.

carla: confirm. metrics: mem.pressure kernel shows huge page-ins on nodes 12-17. continuous-batcher backlog up 250%.

mina: quick hypothesis: recent int8 kernel selection introduced padding change in KV layout -> larger kv bytes on disk when spilling. I saw similar in local repro.

luke: copying logs from node-15: ```
MemTotal: 262144000
KV_cache_bytes: 124823456
KV_spill_to_disk: 89234560
PageIns/sec: 1240
Batcher.backlog: 567
```

sarah: support: two active customers on dedicated capacity showing errors: AcmeAds (low lat, many 504s) and NeptuneHealth (timeout on embeddings). They're on us-west-1 dedicated pools.

oncall-alex: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable continuous batching on affected pools 2) reduce max_batch_size 3) route traffic to fp16/gptq variants where available 4) scale up ephemeral memory if needed. I'll start 1-2 now.

oliver: agree. patch to disable continuous batching: ```yaml
route: us-west-1-serving
continuous_batching: false
max_batch_size: 8
batch_wait_ms: 10
``` applying to pool pg-uw1-0743 via rdwctl now.

deploy-bot: deploy started by oncall-alex @ 1791012392 - config apply to pg-uw1-0743
deploy-bot: all nodes acknowledged config change at 1791012410

carla: flipping batching off now on remaining nodes. also lowering default kv_cache_limit to 256MB.

mina: to confirm root cause: when int8-awq kernel selects the new GEMM tiling path it pads KV stride to 64 bytes, previously 16, which inflated serialized KV by ~3-4x for short sequences. This combined with continuous-batching (longer prefix reuse) increases resident KV drastically -> spill -> page thrash.

oliver: can we force kernel fallback for the variant? yes, adding kernel_override: fp16-gemm for awq-int8 variants until patch. I'll push kernel override to runtime profile.

luke: running: `rdwctl runtime set-kernel pg-uw1-0743 awq-int8 fp16-gemm --force` -> started at 1791012475

sarah: customers notified: sent ack to AcmeAds + NeptuneHealth with ETA 15m for mitigation. they reported latency improved slightly after first config change.

oncall-alex: early signal: paging dropped to 40% within 4m after disabling batching and kernel override. latencies recovering. still watching.

mina: reopening local regression PR to fix padding behavior in awq int8 serializer. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/awq-serializer/pull/482

carla: creating incident channel + handoff notes for tomorrow's rotation. next oncall: oliver at 1801012345. carla taking 1st follow-up runbook item list.

oliver: confirm I'll take full handoff in 2h. immediate follow-ups: 1) revert kernel override once upstream awq fix lands 2) validate kv_cache_size heuristics 3) add alert rule for kv-bytes/token > threshold 4) postmortem + customer RCA.

deploy-bot: rollback candidate created for kernel override. id: rb-1791012501

carla: Customer impact log: AcmeAds saw 504 spike 1791012360-1791012480, ~6% requests affected. NeptuneHealth saw 503s on embeddings ~1791012405-1791012478, ~3% of batched requests. No data loss.

oncall-alex: documenting hotfix commands used: ```bash
# disable continuous batching
rdwctl route apply --pool pg-uw1-0743 --set continuous_batching=false
# lower batch size
rdwctl route apply --pool pg-uw1-0743 --set max_batch_size=8
# kernel override
rdwctl runtime set-kernel pg-uw1-0743 awq-int8 fp16-gemm --force
# flush kv cache on node
rdwctl node exec node-15 -- "rdwctl kv flush --all"
# restart runtime if node still paging
rdwctl node exec node-15 -- "sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime"
```

mina: note: do not re-enable continuous batching on this pool until we patch serializer and validate kv bytes with load test.

carla: I've opened follow-ups: 
- TASK-1768: fix awq-int8 serializer padding regression (eng-ml)
- TASK-1769: add kv-bytes-per-token metric & alert (eng-sre)
- TASK-1770: run canary suite with quantized kernels and batching combos (eng-runtime)
- TASK-1771: customer RCA writeup + outreach (support + product)

oliver: adding one more: update documentation for kernel selection heuristics and expose per-model kv-footprint in model catalog.

oncall-alex: final status: mitigations applied, paging down to healthy levels, impacted customers notified, handoff scheduled. Closing critical paging alert; will leave lower-severity watch alerts for 24h. Good job team :thumbsup:

sarah: tagging support follow-up: timeline to customers + invite to postmortem when complete.

carla: handing off to oliver now. Handoff note: kernel_override active, continuous_batching disabled, max_batch_size 8, monitoring dashboard pinned. last check @ 1791012658 - stable.

oliver: acknowledged, taking over.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: pg-uw1-0743 paging back to normal at 1791012659. Summary saved to /incidents/1791012345/summary.md

carla: postmortem owners assigned. will schedule 1hr sync tomorrow to review regression and roll plan for a safe re-enable.

oliver: thanks everyone.
